commitResults.messageBody:

storage paths follow the packaged JAR. A different caller can therefore
receive logs outside the application home.

percent signs before pattern expansion. Preserve append, rotation,
logging levels and the console fallback.

paths, unavailable logs, concurrent locks and rollover.

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept internal apostrophes in client emails
commitResults.messageBody:
Valid addresses such as sean.o'brien@example.com cannot be recorded
because the supported local punctuation omits ASCII apostrophes.

Accept that character within the existing grammar without changing
first/last-character, dot or domain rules. Cover exact persistence,
rejected mutations, failed saves and long input validation.

Refs #292. Guide integration is reserved for #289.

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify name rules and accept smart apostrophes
commitResults.messageBody:
Name feedback omits its first-character rule, and copied names using
U+2019 cannot be recorded even though ASCII apostrophes work.

Explain the existing initial-character restriction and accept U+2019
without rewriting stored spelling. Preserve literal apostrophe matching
for search and duplicates; cover exact round trips and failure
isolation.

Refs #293 and #294. Guide integration is reserved for #289.

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept single internal separators in tags
commitResults.messageBody:
Alphanumeric-only tags prevent readable categories such as
life-insurance and high_priority.

Allow alphanumeric segments separated by one hyphen or underscore,
retaining root-locale normalization. Use bounded possessive matching
and cover creation, editing, search, reload and failed mutations.
Replace obsolete invalid-tag examples with genuinely invalid inputs.

Refs #295. Guide integration is reserved for #289.
